entities.name: Angola Independence 1975
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Carnation Revolution in Lisbon April 1974; Alvor Accords January 1975; transitional government collapses; MPLA takes Luanda; independence 11 November 1975; South African invasion; Cuban intervention; FNLA defeated.
